authorization: Owner told the orchestrator on 2026-11-22 to use the remaining PixelLab credits today; same-day exception to the retirement rule.
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, mannequin template, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 21) then animate_character v3 per direction (frames come back on a 40x40 canvas, centred on 32x32 without scaling). v3 only makes even frame counts, so idle (3 wanted) keeps frames 0-2 of 4 and telegraph (3 wanted) keeps frames 1-3 of 4; the dropped frames are not shipped. All four facings are separate generations; nothing is mirrored.
prompt: Ash skater, a small chibi gaunt figure with a very large head, ash-grey skin dusted with soot, a ragged dark charcoal hooded cowl, glowing ember-orange eyes, standing on a single long flat curved dark iron skate-runner board under both feet, a long ragged pale grey ash scarf streaming behind it, hooked soot-black claw hands held low, bent forward. Front-facing 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

idle.action_description: hovers in place on its skate board, body swaying slightly side to side, scarf fluttering, ember eyes glowing

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, sways slightly on the skate board, scarf fluttering behind
direction_prompts.west: facing left, sways slightly on the skate board, scarf fluttering to the right
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, sways slightly on the skate board, scarf fluttering
direction_prompts.east: facing right, sways slightly on the skate board, scarf fluttering to the left

walk.action_description: glides forward on its skate board in a fast skating stride, body leaning forward, scarf streaming behind

direction_prompts.south: skates toward the viewer on its board, leaning forward, scarf trailing behind it and hidden
direction_prompts.west: skates to the left on its board, leaning forward, scarf streaming to the right
direction_prompts.north: skates away from the viewer, seen from behind, scarf streaming
direction_prompts.east: skates to the right on its board, leaning forward, scarf streaming to the left

telegraph.action_description: crouches low on its skate board and rears back, claws spread wide and raised, scarf flaring, eyes flaring bright orange, silhouette clearly bigger and spiky before a lunge

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, crouches and rears back, both claws spread wide and raised
direction_prompts.west: facing left, crouches and rears back, claws spread and raised, scarf flaring to the right
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, crouches and rears back, scarf flaring, arms raised
direction_prompts.east: facing right, crouches and rears back, claws spread and raised, scarf flaring to the left

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, lunges toward the viewer slashing both claws across, then returns
direction_prompts.west: facing left, lunges left slashing both claws across, then returns
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, lunges away from the viewer slashing both claws, then returns
direction_prompts.east: facing right, lunges right slashing both claws across, then returns
